properties.description: Pins that a plain get_instructions returns the whole served document however long it grows, and that a caller who names a smaller cap still gets the manifest rather than half a document. It also pins that the root-cause rule rides every channel a session reads unasked: both tiers in the served instructions, ahead of a capped client's cut; the handshake sentence, ending before character 1,200; and the VS Code route file. Positive control: its plain-call test fails against the old 30,000 default.
properties.name: a_plain_get_instructions_returns_the_whole_document_and_the_root_cause_rule_rides_it.rs
